A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RedCodeAgent study and provide complete main text, figures, tables, algorithms, and Appendices A–H. Text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment; the references and appendices are unchanged.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark experiments, attack success and rejection rates, runtime measurements, ablations, and case studies in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons in Tables 1–4 and supplementary experiments in Appendix D.

M1.justification: The memory retrieval and updating, adaptive tool selection, code substitution, and evaluation procedures in Section 3 and Algorithms 1–2 are unchanged. No method component or objective is revised.

E1.justification: Both versions retain RedCode-Exec, RedCode-Gen, RMCbench, Python/C/C++/Java evaluations, and the prompt-injection and SQL-injection scenarios in Appendices D.10–D.11. The added risk-index explanation introduces no new coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments: No Jailbreak, GCG, AmpleGCG, Advprompter, and AutoDAN remain, alongside the same additional template-based, role-play, and five-method-combination comparisons in Appendices D.7–D.8.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendices D–F retain the same sample sizes, model configurations, retry budgets, metrics, and script-based, LLM-based, and keyword-based evaluation procedures. No experimental setting is revised.

E4.justification: The memory, execution-order, penalty-factor, toolset, and base-model analyses remain unchanged, as do prompt-injection, stealthiness, suffix-sensitivity, and case-study evidence. Moving Figures 3–4 does not add or revise their efficiency analyses.

E5.justification: Seed and statistical reporting are unchanged, including GCG seed=42 in Appendix F.3. No repeated-run information, uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance-testing procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: Reported values and findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 retains RedCodeAgent's RedCode-Exec ASRs of 72.47% for OCI and 75.93% for RA; Section 4.3 retains the corresponding 82 and 78 uniquely successful cases.

T1.justification: Algorithm 1's similarity and trajectory-penalty calculations and Appendix D.8's time-cost equations (1)–(2) are unchanged. No formal assumption, mathematical definition, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning automated adaptive red-teaming, sandbox evaluation, effectiveness, efficiency, and discovery of vulnerabilities missed by baselines.

C2.justification: Interpretations of baseline failures, memory benefits, adaptive tool use, and experimental qualifications remain unchanged, along with the misuse caveats in Appendix A. The new risk-index sentence only explains an existing label and points to Figure 6.

D1.justification: The implementation settings, prompts, hyperparameters, model links, and hardware disclosures in Section 4 and Appendix F are unchanged. Appendix A also retains the same planned access restrictions.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. Section 2 lightly edits the sentence citing Cotroneo et al. and Aghakhani et al., preserving its distinction between training-data attacks and attacks on deployed models; the bibliography is identical.

P1.justification: v2 changes the affiliation from UK AI Safety Institute to UK AI Security Institute, makes limited wording and citation-format corrections, and adds a risk-index explanation with a Figure 6 reference in Section 4.1. The narrative and section order remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 3–4 move from page 8 to page 9, surrounding text reflows, and the conclusion extends onto page 10. Figure 5's caption changes 'An case study' to 'A case study'. Figure content and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The Figure 6 pointer and small wording corrections provide slight editorial polish, while the scientific evidence and reproducibility information remain unchanged. Reflow also separates the Section 4.3 heading from its text and splits the conclusion across pages 9–10. These limited presentation effects leave overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
